fixture.maintenanceMutation: Only set session_projection_cache.inline_payload to one-byte invalid JSON; canonical messages, History and source tables untouched.

method.comparison: same running clone process and same four-PID app process tree; idle measured first, maintenance cell measured next; same 24 UI round-trip cycles, with active metrics clipped to the 27.97-second invalidation-to-final-restoration window and idle metrics clipped to equal duration.
method.rssSource: macOS ps RSS KiB, sum over root PID and recursively discovered descendants; summed RSS can count shared pages more than once and is not unique physical memory.

limits: Identity clone, not exact installed app identity or baseline binary.
Synthetic canonical-backed-only sessions; no real user database or full healthy ledger.

This measures summed process-tree RSS during one inline projection-cache invalidation/rebuild workload only; it does not establish RSS for source locator backfill, cold startup, other maintenance, or real histories.

The UI loop ran for about 38 seconds; the eight recorded invalidation/restoration intervals ended at 27.97 seconds. Metrics are limited to that matched 27.97-second window, but no separate per-click timestamp trace is included here.
No Long Task/LoAF attribution, CPU profile, or unique physical-memory measurement is included. This cell alone does not close AC-7/P4-02.
